trial.seed_rule: trial i uses seed base_seed+i; base_seed=20260910

stimulus.type: PoissonInput per GRN, N=1, weight=w_syn*f_poi, refractory of stimulated GRNs set to 0

readout.aggregation_rationale: Post-M1c owner decision: primary L10331; R16949 recorded, not deciding. cells_m1j.json preserves historical cells.json readouts verbatim.
readout.rate_definition: spikes in [0, duration] / duration, mean over trials; also report std over trials

notes: Paper calibrated w_syn on FlyWire v630; we run v783 only, absolute Hz may differ.
Model baseline firing is 0 Hz by construction (no intrinsic activity); condition D measures it anyway.
stop_rule: No further variant, set, gain or threshold change after M1j under this authorization. The ledger becomes nine variants after M1j whatever the result.

shape_gate.S1: At least four of five mean MN9 rates > 0 Hz.
shape_gate.S3: Sugar200 whole-network spike max/min < 3; zero minimum fails (undefined or infinite ratio).
shape_gate.reuse: A provides 25/50/100/200; AP_sugar_120 provides 120. No added S runs.

pass_rule: A, B, C, D, S1, S2, S3 must all pass on this brain's primary MN9; secondary MN9 recorded, not deciding.

stimulation_layout.dedup_rule: Each physical root appears once. A root in sugar_bilateral and water is assigned to sugar.
stimulation_layout.refractory_rule: Inactive units retain ordinary model refractory; driven units have refractory 0.

adoption_rule: Adopt the policy for v2 only if both brains pass. If either fails, reject the policy and close the male line at nine variants.

m1j_provenance.scope: Declaration only; no substrate build, M0 recheck or simulation performed.

declaration_points.1: **Policy under test, framed as a v2 stimulus policy, not a male-only fix:** bilateral typed sugar sets on both brains, LB3b ∪ LB3c both sides from Tastekin Table S1, no pharyngeal or tarsal GRNs. Rationale: the one-sided 23-cell female set is Shiu's benchmark convention, not biology; a fly tasting food uses both labellar palps; docs/v2_decision_memo.md already fixes v2 cell sets to Tastekin typing on both brains. Bitter, water and ir94e sets unchanged for this test. No product, frozen-file or honesty change.
declaration_points.2: **Substrates and sets:** - Male: the M1i ≥5 substrate without autapses (data/malecns/derived/fbm, record substrate_record_fbm.json), w_syn 0.17875 mV; bilateral sugar LB3b ∪ LB3c = 34 (L17/R17), A′ subset LB3c-only bilateral = 23 (L12/R11); bitter 38 / water 17 / ir94e 19 unchanged (data/malecns/cells.json); primary L10331, R16949 recorded. - Female: frozen FlyWire v783 substrate and model (data/stim_protocol.json, w_syn 0.275 mV, all model and trial fields unchanged); bilateral sugar LB3b ∪ LB3c = 57 (LB3b 25: L13/R12; LB3c 32: L20/R12) from the workbook's FlyWire rows (Connectome value 'FAFB – Flywire', Subtype in {LB3b, LB3c}, both Root_Side), A′ subset LB3c-only bilateral = 32; bitter 42 / water 18 / ir94e 18 unchanged (data/cells.json); primary frozen left MN9 720575940660219265, frozen right 720575940618238523 recorded. - Female overlaps, recorded: the 57 keep 12 of the frozen 23 sugar cells and include 7 frozen water cells; 0 overlap with bitter and ir94e. Each physical root appears once, assigned to the sugar channel; water and ir94e channels are 0 Hz in every condition, so no conflict arises. Male typed sets are disjoint. - Physical layouts: male 34+38+17+19 = 108 units; female 57+42+11+18 = 128 units (the 7 water cells that are in the sugar set are counted once, in sugar). Channel order sugar, bitter, water, ir94e; ascending numeric body ID within a channel. Inactive units keep the ordinary refractory period; driven units get refractory 0, exactly as the M1/M1i runners do.
declaration_points.3: **Runs, identical design per brain, seeds 20260910+trial (trial 0..29) for every condition, 1,000 ms, dt 0.1 ms:** A sugar 25/50/100/200 with bitter 0 (120 trials); B sugar 200 with bitter 0/25/50/100/200 (150); C bitter 25/50/100/200 alone (120); D baseline (30); A′ bilateral union versus bilateral LB3c-only at 120 Hz, 30 each, paired seeds (60). 480 per brain, 960 total. Per trial record: both MN9 rates and first-spike latencies, whole-network spike count, neurons fired, source spike counts, Poisson event trains, worker peak RSS, as M1i did.
declaration_points.4: **Gates, unchanged:** A–D historical predicates (sim.malecns.phase0.evaluate_gates, which implements the female Phase 0 predicates of scripts/phase0_report.py; a test must assert the two agree on the female summaries), S1 (≥4 of the 5 sugar levels 25/50/100/120/200 positive), S2 (each adjacent decrease ≤ pooled population SD), S3 (sugar 200 whole-network spike count max/min < 3; zero minimum fails), from sim.malecns.split.shape_gate, on each brain's primary MN9. **Pass rule per brain:** A, B, C, D, S1, S2, S3. **Adoption rule:** the policy is adopted for v2 only if both brains pass. If either fails, the policy is rejected and the male line closes at nine variants. **Stop rule:** no further variant, set, gain or threshold change after M1j under this authorization.
declaration_points.5: **Retention table:** male, outgoing synapses of the 34 bilateral sugar cells (and the 23-cell A′ subset) at ≥1 versus ≥5, same layout as M1i's table, recorded not deciding. Female frozen graph has no cut: its table records outgoing synapse totals of the 57 cells only, no retention fraction, and says so.
declaration_points.6: **Environment check before any M1j trial:** rerun the M0 benchmark, baseline and sugar 200, 5 trials each, seeds 20260910–20260914, whole-CNS all-edge male substrate (data/malecns/derived/connectivity.parquet) at 0.275 mV with the 91-unit M0 layout, from the committed code via the same trial routine (SimNet.run_trial as sim/malecns/benchmark.py uses), into a separate write-once directory data/malecns/runs/m0_recheck. Compare every neuron's spike-time array in each of the 10 trials with the stored data/malecns/runs/m0 files exactly (same neuron keys, arrays equal). Identical: recorded in the M1j section and M1j proceeds. Any difference: stop, no M1j trial, report to the owner. The stored M0 provenance names older versions of some source files; this check is what tells whether later edits changed the numbers.
declaration_points.7: **Owner addition, recorded (not a rule):** because the female bilateral sugar set includes 7 frozen water cells, a v2 re-typing must redefine the water set as LB3a as well, not only sugar. Add this as a follow-up line in docs/v2_decision_memo.md (in the v2 cell-set / policy area; keep the memo's style and word budget).
declaration_points.8: **Sequence:** declaration commit → cell files, protocols, retention tables, runners with compile-only plans (internal checkpoint) → M0 recheck (stop if not identical) → male run → female run → independent audit → results section with both gate tables and both sugar curves side by side → memo and OQ updates → PR into dev. One report to the owner at the end.

m0_recheck.trial_routine: SimNet.run_trial as sim/malecns/benchmark.py uses, from committed code
m0_recheck.comparison: Every neuron in every one of the 10 trials: identical neuron keys and exactly equal spike-time arrays.
m0_recheck.on_match: Record in M1j section; M1j may proceed.
m0_recheck.on_difference: Stop; no M1j trial; report to owner.
m0_recheck.reason: Stored M0 provenance names older source versions; exact comparison checks whether later edits changed numbers.

seed_scheme.R1_difference: R1 used the published grid formula 20260910+1000*(seed_index%40)+trial; M1j uses M1 seeds.

m1j_provenance.gate_agreement_test_required: Assert sim.malecns.phase0.evaluate_gates agrees with scripts/phase0_report.py on female summaries before running.
